extracted.intended_audience: editors, typesetters, proofreaders, authors, and designers using the University of Chicago Manual of Style
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and conventions for copyediting, typography, punctuation, capitalization, and typesetting as presented in a style manual (University of Chicago). Intended to guide preparing and setting text for publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sizes of type
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on sizes of type in ordinary use; samples of sizes are provided (see p. 252).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes standard measurement of type sizes and specimen samples for reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small caps
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and indication of small caps; guidance on use of small caps (see p. 52, 257).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how small caps are indicated in copy and when their use is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small pica
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of the small pica size (see p. 252).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the size and typical uses of the small pica type size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: social organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization rules for names of social organizations (see p. 11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies which words in organization names are capitalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyphenation: soft c or g
rubrics_metrics.description: Rule that soft c or g should not be divided at line breaks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not hyphenate/divide words so that a soft c or soft g is split across lines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: solar-system bodies in astronomy works
rubrics_metrics.description: Guideline for capitalization of names of bodies in the solar system when in works on astronomy (see p. 48).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies capitalization conventions appropriate to scientific/astronomical contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of typographical terms (e.g., 'Solid')
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions of typographical terms such as 'Solid' (see p. 297).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Style manual provides definitions of technical typographic vocabulary to ensure consistent usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spaces: sizes and specimens
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of different sizes of spaces and specimens of lines spaced with different sizes (see pp. 258–63).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes thin, thick, em/quads, and other space sizes with sample illustrations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spacing: general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for spacing various elements: divisional signs, figure columns in tables, formulae, headlines, metric symbols, monetary symbols, numerals at paragraph starts, reading-matter in ruled tables, rules in tables, Scripture passages, short words (pp. 258–73).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies standard spacing and what is considered good spacing (standard on p. 264); includes samples with different sizes of spaces (p. 263).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: Spanish titles of publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of capitals in Spanish-language titles of publications (see p. 42).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives language-specific capitalization rules for Spanish titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific names (species): capitals and italics
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of capitals and italics in scientific names of species (see p. 46).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates which parts of scientific names are capitalized and which should be italicized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimen examples of table layout and formatting (see p. 250).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides model tables illustrating recommended table setting practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to spell out words, phrases, and titles
rubrics_metrics.description: List and rules of words, phrases, and titles that are to be spelled out (pp. 92–105).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates contexts (e.g., numbers, titles) where a word or number should be spelled out rather than abbreviated or numeraled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling conventions (multiple categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Extensive spelling rules: words with multiple spellings, ages, books of the Bible, centuries, Christian names, 'Company'/'Brothers' in firm names, decades, Egyptian dynasties, extracts from modern authors and Old English, indefinite articles before h/u, metric symbols, names of months, names of publications, regiments, numbers starting sentences, numbers <3 digits, possessives for names ending in sibilant, 'Railroad'/'Railway', round numbers, 'Saint', sessions of Congress, states and territories, sums of money, time of day, titles, 'United States', words denoting subsections in literary references, and general rules (pp. 92–119).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives specific spelled-out forms and exceptions for many categories; consult the indicated pages for lists and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: squares
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization rules for names of squares (see p. 8).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies treatment of place-name elements like 'Square'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard of measurement in typography
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard units of measurement used in typography (see p. 252); includes the standard space used to separate words (p. 261).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines typographic measurement units (points, picas, ems) and the recommended word-separating space.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: 'State'
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when the word 'State' is to be capitalized (see p. 28, note).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives contexts and examples for capitalization of governmental-designation words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviations and treatment: states and territories
rubrics_metrics.description: List of abbreviations for states and territories and rule that names should be abbreviated when following town names (see p. 106).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies preferred postal/print abbreviations and placement-based abbreviation rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistics: treatment of numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to treat numbers in statistical contexts (see p. 94).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes numeral vs. spelled-out conventions for statistical presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compounds with 'Store'
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for forming compounds with 'Store' (see p. 188).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows whether hyphenation or closed form is appropriate for such compounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition and usage of 'Stub' (typographic head)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of 'Stub' and the head for it (see p. 241).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the typographic element and its usage in tables/indices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Styles of type
rubrics_metrics.description: Descriptions and rules for styles of type (pp. 253–57).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers italic, roman, bold, condensed, etc., and when to use each style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compounds with prefixes: 'Sub', 'Super', 'Supra', 'Tri-', 'Ultra', 'Un-', 'Under'
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing formation and hyphenation of compounds with these prefixes (pp. 197, 205–09).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides spelling/hyphenation conventions for common prefix compounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subdivisions in literary references
rubrics_metrics.description: Use lower-case for subdivisions in literary references; letters indicating subdivisions to be set in italics; use of parentheses with subdivisions (see pp. 54, 66, 82, 236).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains typographic treatment of book/article subdivisions and how to display them in references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffix or prefix indicated by hyphen
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate suffix or prefix with a hyphen when necessary (see p. 212).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies marking affixes in morphological or typographic contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: 'Sultan' and similar titles
rubrics_metrics.description: When to capitalize 'Sultan' and comparable titles (see p. 21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives rules for capitalization of formal titles in various contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of dashes with summarizing clauses
rubrics_metrics.description: Use dashes in connection with summarizing clauses (see p. 170).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when a dash is appropriate to introduce or set off a summarizing element.

rubrics_metrics.name: Superior figures for reference indices
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of superior figures (superscripts) for reference indices (see pp. 231, 238).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides formatting of footnote/reference markers and index numeration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Superscriptions: omission of period after
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on omitting a period after superscriptions (see p. 125).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies punctuation conventions following superscriptions and headings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: names and pronouns for the Supreme Being
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization of names for the Supreme Being and pronouns referring to it (see p. 24).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives religious/usage-based capitalization rules and scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: Swedish titles of publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of capitals in Swedish-language titles of publications (see p. 42).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Language-specific capitalization guidance for Swedish.

rubrics_metrics.name: Syllabi: notation scheme and indentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Scheme of notation and indentation of subdivisions in syllabi (see p. 176).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommends hierarchical numbering/indentation formats for course syllabi.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of hyphen to indicate syllables
rubrics_metrics.description: Hyphen used to indicate syllable breaks (see p. 213).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides syllabification markings, especially in dictionaries or teaching texts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symbols: chemical, metric, monetary, and measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment and spacing rules for chemical symbols, metric symbols, monetary symbols, and measurement abbreviations (see pp. 111, 123, 269–70, iii).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies spacing and formatting for symbols and units; includes abbreviation conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tables: setting rules and varieties
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for setting tables: headlines, open vs. ruled tables, two-column tables set as open, more-than-two columns as ruled, open table column headlines, ruled table box-heads, rules for use of rules in tables, specimen tables, and setting to even picas or nonpareils (pp. 240–50, 246, 248–50).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides detailed formatting instructions for tables, including when to use rules/lines and how to set column heads and widths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tabular work: overall rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General rules for tabular work (see pp. 240–50).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-references the detailed table-setting guidance and specimens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical terms: explanation and use of quotation marks
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of typographical technical terms and when to use quotation marks for technical words or phrases (pp. 251–94, p. 77).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes between typographic definition entries and use of quotation marks to signal technical terms or unusual usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of 'The' in newspaper and magazine titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not treat 'The' as part of the title of newspapers or magazines (see p. 43).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Omit 'The' when alphabetizing or citing titles in bibliographies according to the manual's conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions: thick and thin spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions of thick space (p. 261) and thin space (p. 262).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives typographic measurements and appropriate uses for each space size.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thin-spacing: where to avoid
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on where to avoid thin-spacing (see p. 265).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists contexts in which thin-spacing would produce poor readability or typographic problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: thoroughfares; spelling of numbers in names
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization rules for names of thoroughfares (see p. 8) and rule that numbers forming part of names of thoroughfares are to be spelled out (see p. 100).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains place-name capitalization and number treatment within those names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Thousands: comma usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of comma after digits indicating thousands (see p. 159).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides numeric punctuation rules for thousands separators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three-em and two-em dashes/quads/spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions and illustrations of three-em dash, three-em quad, three-em space (p. 259, 261, 263) and two-em dash, two-em quad (p. 259, 263).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives measurements and visual examples for long dashes/quads and their uses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time indications and time of day
rubrics_metrics.description: How to punctuate time indications (p. 134) and treatment of time of day (p. 98).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies punctuation and style for expressing time in running text and in schedules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles: capitalization and spelling rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization of civil, military, honorary, nobility titles, in direct address and preceding names; titles preceding names to be spelled out; list of exceptions and special parts of titles (e.g., 'vice', 'ex-', 'elect', 'general', 'lieutenant') and how to treat them (pp. 21, 92, 201).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains which parts of a title are capitalized in different syntactic positions and when to spell out abbreviations in names/titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles of legal causes and proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles of legal causes and proceedings are to be italicized (see p. 63).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies typographic treatment for case names in legal citations and running text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles of publications: capitalization, italics, and quoting
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization of principal words in titles of publications (p. 41); use of capitals in various languages (p. 42); use of italics for titles (p. 60); roman-quoting of titles (pp. 80–82); correct quoting and when titles are to be spelled out (pp. 60, 80–82, 105, 112).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed guidance on typographical and casing treatment of titles across genres and languages, including exceptions for short poems, articles, and divisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting 'To be continued' at ends of articles
rubrics_metrics.description: How to set the phrase 'To be continued' at the end of articles (see p. 73).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides typographic conventions for serial continuation notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date line: town and state names
rubrics_metrics.description: How to set town and state names in the dateline (see p. 50).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies punctuation, abbreviation, and formatting of datelines for news and announcements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles of tracts, transactions, treatises, and toasts
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization of principal words and italicization/roman-quoting rules for tracts (p. 41, 60, 52), transactions of societies (p. 60), treatises (p. 60), and toasts (p. 41, 82).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies the general titles rules to these specific document types, noting language/style differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of dash to indicate transition
rubrics_metrics.description: Use dash to indicate transition in text (see p. 166).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies rhetorical/typographic function of dash as transition marker.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation: names and foreign words
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on translating names of foreign institutions (pp. 11, 59) and translating foreign words or phrases (p. 78).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes when to translate institutional names and how to present foreign-language material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: treaties
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization rules for names of treaties (see p. 18).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when treaty names are treated as proper nouns and capitalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: tribes, races, and peoples
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization rules for names and epithets of tribes, races, and peoples (see p. 47).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides sensitive and consistent usage for ethnonyms and related epithets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization: Trinity and names of members
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization of names of members of the Christian Trinity (see p. 24).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Religious-usage capitalization rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-column tables: open setting
rubrics_metrics.description: Two-column tables should be set as open (see p. 248).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the recommended table format for two-column tabular data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-letter syllables: avoidance in divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid two-letter syllables in section/division labels (see p. 216).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advises against very short subdivision labels to maintain clarity and aesthetics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type anatomy and naming
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of different parts of the body of type (p. 256) and names for different sizes of type (p. 252); styles of type (pp. 253–57).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides reference for typographic vocabulary and how to refer to type features and sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typesetting machines
rubrics_metrics.description: References and guidance on typesetting machines (see pp. 293–94).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical/technical notes about equipment and their typographic implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typographical terms: explanations
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanations of typographical terms (pp. 251–94).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as a glossary for typographic and printing terminology used throughout the manual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indefinite article: long-u before
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of the long-u form of the indefinite article before words beginning with a long 'u' sound (see p. 114).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides choice of 'a' vs. 'an' based on pronunciation rather than spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unit (typographical) and units of measurement
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of typographical unit (p. 251) and rule that units of measurement are spelled with lowercase initial letters (see p. 55).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies casing and representation of measurement units in running text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of 'United States'
rubrics_metrics.description: When 'United States' is to be spelled out and when it may be abbreviated (see p. 103).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives contexts and stylistic guidance for using the full name versus abbreviation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution-specific capitalization (University of Chicago)
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization of special terms dealing with organization, administration, curricula, and titles of divisions, departments, officers, and courses in official work dealing with the University of Chicago (see p. 49).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows institution-specific style practices to be used in official university publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quotation marks for unusual words or phrases
rubrics_metrics.description: Use quotation marks for unusual words or phrases or words accompanied by their definition (pp. 76–79).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies when to flag unusual or defined terms with quotation marks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name-particle rules: 'Van' and 'Von'
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for treatment of particles like 'Van' and 'Von' in personal names (see p. 239).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains capitalization and alphabetization considerations for names with particles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of verbs in titles and verbs derived from proper names
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalization of verbs in titles of publications (p. 41) and treatment of verbs derived from proper names (p. 53).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies when verbs are capitalized in title-case and how to treat derived verbs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting fractional verse/page letters
rubrics_metrics.description: A letter affixed to verse or page numbers to denote fractional parts should be set in italic; spacing guidance for these (see p. 66).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescribes typographic treatment of fractional reference markers in scholarly editions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versions of the Bible: abbreviations and capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Abbreviations for versions of the Bible and capitalization rules (see p. 30).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives standard forms for citing Bible versions and their styling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verso definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition of 'verso' (see p. 283).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Terminology entry for page-side vocabulary used in typesetting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versus abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of 'v.' or 'vs.' as abbreviation for 'versus' (see p. 59).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates preferred abbreviation in legal and general contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of 'Vice' prefixed to titles
rubrics_metrics.description: How to treat the prefix 'Vice' when it is attached to titles (see p. 201).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies capitalization and punctuation for such prefixed titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vocative 'O'
rubrics_metrics.description: Treatment of the vocative 'O' (see p. 117).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies punctuation and typographic treatment when addressing persons or entities with 'O'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviations in literary references ('Vol.', 'chap.', 'p.')
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of numerals with abbreviations such as 'vol.', 'chap.', 'p.' in literary references and when such abbreviations are omitted (see p. 236).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for citing parts of works in bibliographic/literary reference formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vowel division in hyphenation
rubrics_metrics.description: Divide on vowels whenever possible; single vowel forming a separate syllable in the middle of a word should be placed in the first line when dividing (see p. 224).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides hyphenation rules based on syllable structure to maintain readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metric weights and measures: designation and spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: How to designate metric weights and measures (p. 111) and spacing rules for them (p. 269).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies symbol use, abbreviation, and spacing conventions for metric units.

rubrics_metrics.name: 'Whereas' in resolutions: capitalization and small caps
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of capitals and small caps for 'Whereas' in resolutions (see p. 51).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prescribes typographic style for formal resolutions and legal documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wide spacing: where to avoid
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on where to avoid wide spacing (see p. 265).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists contexts where excessive interword or interletter spacing harms typography.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quoting a word or phrase accompanied by its definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Words or phrases accompanied by their definition should be quoted; use quotation marks for words to which attention is directed (pp. 76, 79).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies presentation of defined or highlighted terms within text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyphenated words: list and rules
rubrics_metrics.description: List of words hyphenated (p. 214) and rules for words with more than one accepted spelling (p. 119).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides canonical hyphenation and spelling choices and lists of exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compounds with 'Work' and 'World'
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for forming compounds with 'Work' (p. 186) and 'World' (p. 192).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates hyphenation/closed form guidance for these common bases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zoological terms: capitalization and italics
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of capitals in zoological terms and use of italics (see pp. 46, 71).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parallel to botanical/scientific naming rules: indicates which taxonomic ranks or names require italics or capitalization.
